_notes: Equipment catalogue. Masses in kg, power in kW (negative = uses power; solar output is at Earth's distance from the Sun and falls with distance squared), costs in millions of dollars.
tier 0 = available from the start; higher tiers are for the tech tree (everything is shown for now).
relaunch: a stage that can take off again from a surface it landed on.

launchers.name: Medium launcher
launchers.description: The workhorse: crewed Moon trips fit on one.

launchers.name: Super-heavy launcher
launchers.description: For the biggest single items, like terraforming equipment.

stages.name: Storable chemical stage
stages.description: Simple and reliable. Modest fuel efficiency.

stages.name: Reusable lander stage
stages.description: Small and cheap, and can take off again from where it lands: hops crews off the Moon.

stages.name: Methalox stage
stages.description: The workhorse: big tanks and able to relaunch. Mars landings and Moon return trips.

stages.name: Hydrolox stage
stages.description: Best chemical efficiency and the biggest tanks: hauls heavy cargo like a habitat down to Mars.

stages.name: Nuclear thermal stage
stages.description: Twice as efficient as chemical, but heavy and expensive. Mercury and big Venus missions.

stages.name: Ion stage
stages.description: Superb efficiency, tiny push: a full tank takes about 100 days to burn. A slow, cheap cargo tug.

stages.name: Torch drive
stages.description: Nobody is quite sure how it works, or why the engineers keep smiling. Goes anywhere, comes back, and does it again.

modules.name: Crew capsule (2 seats)
modules.description: Carries crew between places. Not a shelter once landed.

modules.name: Surface shelter (2)
modules.description: Small shelter for short surface stays. Crew landing without a habitat place die.

modules.name: Supply pod
modules.description: 200 kg food and 300 kg water (about 16 months for 2 crew).

modules.name: Solar array
modules.description: 3 kW at Earth's distance from the Sun; less further out (43% at Mars).

modules.name: Large solar array
modules.description: 15 kW at Earth's distance from the Sun.

modules.name: Water recycler
modules.description: Recovers 80% of the water crew use.

modules.name: Greenhouse farm
modules.description: Grows enough food for one crew member.

modules.name: Science satellite
modules.description: Carried on board, then left behind in orbit (Deploy satellite, once the craft has settled in orbit). Earns science points.

modules.name: Fission reactor
modules.description: 100 kW anywhere, however far from the Sun. What a terraforming base runs on.

modules.name: Atmosphere factory
modules.description: Terraforming stage 1 (Mars surface, needs crew and power): pumps greenhouse gases into the air to warm and thicken it.

modules.name: Orbital mirror
modules.description: Terraforming stage 2 (Mars orbit, no crew needed): focuses sunlight on the poles to melt the ice caps.

modules.name: Biosphere lab
modules.description: Terraforming stage 3 (Mars surface, needs crew and power): grows and spreads hardy microbes, moss and lichen.
